integrity.proof_type: analytic graph-incidence and Grover coin argument

scientific_limitations: The theorem constructs non-unit-eigenvalue modes in the all-positive conserved-spin sector only. It does not prove generic initial-state localization or settle the eigenvalue-one fixed-point conjecture.
The eigenspace dimensions are rigorous dimensions of explicit orthogonal subspaces and lower bounds on full eigenspace multiplicities, not claims of full spectral decomposition.
General two-tessellable cycle-eigenstate theory may yield a different route to some modes; independent priority review remains necessary.
title: Shell-flow eigenspaces and six-site localization in every hypercube dimension
